Two spec packages in this repository share the number 13:
.specs/13_replace_variant_with_effort and
.specs/13_tool_call_counts_and_relevant_files. Both were written by `spec`,
on different days, and nobody renamed either by hand.

`impl 13` now refuses to choose between them, and every cross-reference
that says "spec 13" is ambiguous. I expected `spec` to give the second
package 14, the way it numbers a split's follow-on packages one after the
other. Either `spec` does not look at every package when it picks the next
number, or something else wrote the second package while the first was not
yet in the tree.
